<a name="member-formatDecimal-28-long-2c-int-29-"></a>

### `formatDecimal(long,int)`

```java
public static String formatDecimal(long value, int width)
```

Renders a decimal integer, left-padding with spaces to the minimum width.
This Ironwood helper accepts no format string or Formatter flags.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | integer to render |
| `width` | nonnegative minimum field width; zero adds no padding |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](IllegalArgumentException.md) | if width is negative |

**Returns**

a caller-owned String, never truncated to fit the width


[Back to member summary](#member-summary)

<a name="member-formatFixed-28-double-2c-int-2c-int-29-"></a>

### `formatFixed(double,int,int)`

```java
public static String formatFixed(double value, int width, int precision)
```

Renders bounded fixed-point text, left-padding with spaces to the minimum
width. The magnitude is scaled by a power of ten and rounded with
Math.round; the sign, including negative zero, is preserved. Nonfinite
values render as NaN, Infinity, or -Infinity without fractional digits.
This Ironwood helper does not implement Java Formatter decimal rounding.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | floating value to render |
| `width` | nonnegative minimum field width; zero adds no padding |
| `precision` | fractional digit count from zero through nine |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](IllegalArgumentException.md) | if width or precision is out of range, or the finite magnitude exceeds the long-based scaling range |

**Returns**

a caller-owned String, never truncated to fit the width
